units.text: The emulator's own working memory can reach 2 GB in a heavy game, nearly all of it cold, and iOS counts it against the app even when it sits compressed. Automatic starts using the swap file for it only once the app's memory reaches about 3 GB, so the game runs at full speed until it needs the room (a server world loading, say). On always puts it in the file from the start, which saves the most memory and slows the game the most. Both need Swap covers set to Wide and a big enough swap size (set swap-mb on the game's Engine page for more than 4 GB). If a game gets slower, stutters or stops working, turn it off. Applies to the next start.
